$comment: The holding's stations (docs/design/holding.md). id: kebab-case, the basket is basket:<id>, stored in the ledger so never renamed; kind: post | trees | outcrop (the layout's legend letter); name: display name; action (none for the post): name, the yield (itemId, quantity per cycle), cycleMs, the skill it trains and the XP per cycle (GAME DESIGN's curve: the action's base time in seconds). The living branch, regrowth and the quarry's layers come later with their items.
